Problem: Write a python function to check whether the two numbers differ at one bit position only or not.
Signature: differ_At_One_Bit_Pos(int, int) -> bool

reply:
```t
t 1
gate loops
task mbpp_509__average_Odd(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 1
  requires n % 2 == 1
  ensures 2 * r == n + 1
{
  r := (n + 1) / 2;
}
```
